GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: Count Threat Signals articles by relevance band
GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Beta. Counts the account's Threat Signals articles in each relevance band, for each active Priority Intelligence Requirement and across all of them. Uses the same PIRs as article relevance: active PIRs, including those the matcher paused; drafts and deleted PIRs are excluded. Articles not scored against a PIR are not counted for it. The combined counts place each article once, in the band of its best score, so they are not the sum of the per-PIR counts. All counts are read together and are exact.

schema.description: Include articles published at or after this ISO 8601 date-time with Z or a numeric UTC offset; normalized to UTC.
Include articles published at or before this ISO 8601 date-time with Z or a numeric UTC offset; normalized to UTC.

articles.description: Beta. Number of articles in each band, each counted once, in the band of its best score across the active PIRs. Not the sum of the per-PIR counts: an article can be relevant to several PIRs. Articles not scored against any active PIR are not counted.

priorities.description: Beta. Each active PIR, including PIRs the matcher paused, ordered by ID. Drafts and deleted PIRs are excluded.

articles.description: Beta. Number of articles in each band of their score against this PIR. Articles not scored against it are not counted.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: Count Threat Signals articles by severity band
GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Beta. Counts the account's Threat Signals articles in each intrinsic severity band. An article's band is the severity level nearest its severity, from informational to critical. Articles without a severity are not counted. Also counts, for each active Priority Intelligence Requirement, the articles scored against it. min_relevance counts only articles at or above a relevance band: overall, for any active PIR; per PIR, for that PIR, the same rule as the per-PIR relevance counts. pir_id counts for one active PIR only. Like the article severity field, severity is reported only while the account has an active Priority Intelligence Requirement, including one the matcher paused; otherwise every count is zero and priorities is empty. All counts are read together and are exact.

schema.description: Include articles published at or after this ISO 8601 date-time with Z or a numeric UTC offset; normalized to UTC.
Include articles published at or before this ISO 8601 date-time with Z or a numeric UTC offset; normalized to UTC.

Beta. Active Priority Intelligence Requirement to count for. articles then counts only articles scored against it, min_relevance applies to its score, and priorities lists only it. Returns a 400 error unless the PIR is active.

Beta. Count only articles at or above this relevance band: in articles, for any active Priority Intelligence Requirement, as the article list's min_relevance does without pir_id; in each priority, for that PIR. Excludes articles that have not been scored against an active PIR.

articles.description: Beta. Number of articles in each severity band: the severity level nearest the article's severity. Articles without a severity are not counted, and every count is zero when the account has no active Priority Intelligence Requirements.

priorities.description: Beta. Each active PIR, including PIRs the matcher paused, ordered by ID. Drafts and deleted PIRs are excluded. An article can count toward several PIRs, so these are not parts of articles.

articles.description: Beta. Number of articles scored against this PIR in each severity band. With min_relevance, only articles whose relevance to this PIR is at or above that band. Articles without a severity are not counted.

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Replaces the ordered custom skills assigned to a Threat Signals feed. Requires a paid Threat Signals subscription.

schema.description: UUID of the Threat Signals feed

skill_ids.description: Ordered array of Custom Skill UUIDs (max 20). Replaces the feed's custom skill assignments. Free accounts cannot assign custom skills. Managed default skills are unaffected.

custom_feed_count.description: The current count of custom feeds for the account.

custom_feed_limit.description: The custom feed limit for the account.

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: Replace Threat Signals skill tag categories
PUT /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Replaces the Tag Categories the managed default tagging skill may select tags from. This configures the managed default tagging skill, not Custom Skills.

schema.description: Must be default-tagging-skill; configures the managed default tagging skill

category_uuids.description: Up to 100 unique tag category UUIDs that the managed default tagging skill may select tags from.
